question: The tomb of Itmad-ud-Daula (or Itimad-Ud-Daulah) is situated in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Itmad -ud Daula is the **first monument** in India** built entirely with marble**.
 
• The tomb was built between **1622-1628.**
 
• **Nur Jehan** built this tomb, for her father **Mirja-GhiyasBeg.**
 
• The tomb is situated on the **Western bank** of the **Jamuna river.**
 
• The dome is similar to** Parisian architecture.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** About the Agra**

 
 
• Agra is the city of** Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The Sultan** Sikander Lodhi** (Delhi-Sultanate) founded** Agra in the year 1504.**
 
• Agra was also known as** Akbrabad** in the Mughal era.
 
• Agra is too famous for the **Taj Mahal.**
 
• Some important Architectural buildings in Agra, are the **Taj Maha**l,** Agra Fort, Sheesh mahal, Jahangir mahal, and Lodhi tomb**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** Fatehpur Sikri**-is Famous for is the **capital of Mughal Empire, Akbar **time.
 
• **Shahjahanabad**-It was founded as a walled city named Shahjahanabad in **1639**
 
 
• when** Shah Jahan** (the Mughal emperor at the time) decided to shift the** Mughal capital from Agra.**
 
 
 
• ​**Aurangabad **is a city in** Maharashtra state**, India.
 
 
• It’s known for the 17th-century marble** Bibi ka Maqbara **shrine, styled on the Taj Maha.
